title: RAW UNREVIEWED: an ambiguous two-style minim stream with one explicitly encoded source-space sign
summary: An invented source-stream writing relation uses the23-letter alphabet without J/U/W. I,N,M,V become homogeneous runs of one chosen e or i working unit of widths1,2,3,2; the other19letters and SPACE use the remaining20units bijectively. The set-valued reader discards physical layout gaps but reconstructs source spaces from one fixed literal unit, retaining every ambiguous letter decomposition. Adjacent space signs are impossible; source-word fragments have a key-independent minimum letter count. No word-length cap, natural-language lexicon, native values, historical attestation or explanatory layout law is supplied.

design.purpose: A concrete ambiguity-aware stream-channel hypothesis with a paid source-word boundary, distinct from complete-visible-group letter codes or one-source-word/one-visible-group spelling. It is not a claim that any actual Voynich word means anything.

source_domain.messages: A nonempty finite sequence of nonempty words over exactly this alphabet, joined by exactly one source SPACE. No leading/trailing SPACE and no empty source words.
source_domain.normalization_limit: The source domain is already restricted. No existing source text is silently uppercased, stripped of punctuation, transliterated or rewritten here. J/U/W, digits, punctuation, case distinctions and source paragraph marks are outside this exact domain. No escape branch exists. A future normalization contract would need to declare and retain its losses independently.
source_domain.language_limit: This is a23-letter orthographic alphabet convention, not a supplied Latin lexicon or grammar. Arbitrary nonempty strings are legal words. There is NO maximum word length and no ban on repeated source words or repeated source letters.

working_inventory.literal_key: One globally fixed bijection from these20roles to the20working units other than e/i. Its SPACE image h is therefore one of exactly20candidate units, never e or i. No literal value is chosen for a native unit in this proposal.
working_inventory.entry_cost: 20literal entries plus8labeled letter/style alternatives. N and V share both length2 alternatives, so there are26distinct written code strings. The22working drawings are not a22-entry uniquely decodable letter table.

writer: Reject a source outside the declared domain; do not normalize it occurrence by occurrence.
Write each ordinary literal letter through the fixed20-role table. Write every source SPACE as the same h unit.

For each individual occurrence of I,N,M,V, choose either e style or i style and write exactly the specified number1,2,3,2of that one unit. A single source letter may not mix styles. Consecutive same-style runs concatenate without a hidden separator.
Preserve source order. There are no nulls, state changes, hidden separators, padding or resets that add/remove source characters.

Physical visible spaces and line breaks may be inserted BETWEEN complete working units as layout; they carry no source information. No physical grouping distribution or choice rule is supplied, and no source-word/visible-group correspondence is claimed. This unbound formatter is a substantive missing native explanatory component.
reader: Recognize the22complete working units first, respecting existing unit boundaries. Remove only display gaps/line breaks between units. In a transcription implementation, flatten already parsed unit lists; do not erase raw EVA ASCII gaps and retokenize, which could manufacture ch/sh/other compound units.
Under one fixed literal key, decode every non-e/i unit directly. In particular h restores source SPACE rather than a displayed gap.

For each maximal homogeneous e run or i run of length r, enumerate every ordered composition of r into1,2,3. Replace1byI,3byM, and each2independently by eitherN orV. A source letter cannot cross an e/i style change or a literal unit.

Combine all run choices with the literal letters and exact source spaces. For a COMPLETE message require the declared nonempty-word/single-space grammar. Return every compatible normalized source spelling; do not select a reading by an unspecified language model or expected meaning.

For a clipped admitted snippet, allow its ends inside source words or minim-letter runs. Treat only observed h units as exact source-space positions. Do not falsely require the snippet itself to begin/end at a source-word or codeword boundary.

inverse_scope.guarantee: Every message actually emitted by this writing relation belongs to the returned finite preimage set for the complete observed stream.
inverse_scope.not_guaranteed: The original message is generally NOT uniquely recovered. For example ee can encode N, V or II; eee can encode M, IN, IV, NI, VI or III. These are real source-spelling distinctions, not alternative names for one meaning. No claim of exact source meaning recovery is made.
inverse_scope.completeness: Every enumerated run decomposition can be rendered back using the style of that run; literal units and source spaces are exact under the key. Thus the returned set is precisely the compatible source spellings under the declared channel, not a list chosen to contain a favored answer.
inverse_scope.complexity: Direct human reading uses run lengths and a20-row literal table. The number of candidate spellings can grow exponentially with run length and number of runs. A practical linguistic disambiguator remains absent and would require independently supplied grammar/lexicon.

source_only_examples.point: The h unit reconstructs the source word boundary; inserting or removing DISPLAY gaps does not alter it. The second word remains ambiguous between N,V andII.

source_only_examples.stream_description: Fifteen e units if all seven letters use e style, because3+1+2+1+3+2+3=15.
source_only_examples.point: No run cap, literal-name exception or later escape is introduced. Other per-letter style choices are permitted but must keep each letter homogeneous.
MI or IM attain the lower bound; a single source letter cannot emit4units.
Style changes force separate letters. Applying ceil(total minim units/3) across different styles would be wrong.

necessary_consequences.space_exclusion: For a candidate h, observed adjacent hh inside one genuinely continuous unit snippet is impossible: it would be two consecutive source spaces with no nonempty source word between. A displayed gap between the two units does not rescue it. An unobserved/uncertain interval must break the snippet rather than be deleted.
necessary_consequences.word_length_bound: Remove observed h separators. For each resulting nonempty segment S, let L_h(S) be the number of units in S outside e/i, plus the sum of ceil(r/3) over every maximal homogeneous e-run and i-run in S. Then every compatible complete source word containing that segment has at least L_h(S) letters.
necessary_consequences.proof: Each literal unit in S consumes one source letter. Each minim source letter emits at most3same-style units; covering an r-unit homogeneous run requires at leastceil(r/3)letters. Letters cannot cross a literal or style boundary. The contributions therefore add. If a snippet clips an endpoint letter, its observed portion still has length at most3; clipping cannot lower the bound on the containing full source word.
necessary_consequences.aggregation: For each surviving h, the strongest reported word-length lower bound over the fixed snippets is B_h=max_S L_h(S). The family-wide unavoidable bound is min_h B_h over ALL surviving h. Display all candidates rather than choosing a convenient marker. If no h survives the hard hh constraint, the family fails on that fixed continuity scope.
necessary_consequences.empty_edges: An empty leading/trailing segment of a clipped snippet is not an empty source word and adds no positive bound. An internal empty segment between hh is forbidden. Leading/trailing h only contradicts a complete-message boundary if that boundary is independently established.
necessary_consequences.no_unregistered_gate: There is no30-letter or other source-word-length cutoff in this base family. A large B_h is an explicit cost, not a Latin/cipher/language exclusion. A future independently fixed source word inventory or maximum-length contract may make the bound decisive; none is selected, normalized or counted here.

known_limits: Actual physical identity and segmentation of the22working units, especially e/i, remain hypotheses. No image or new transcription evidence is supplied.
All native printed group/line breaks are ignored only under this declared stream hypothesis. Their known structural information is not explained by calling them layout.
The minim style-choice law is not given probabilistically; no native run-frequency or whole-form fit follows. This is not the failed1328independent geometric continuation model.

Old AAA and daldy/group-edge observations remain facts.975's bounded-language AAA contradiction and930's fixed-three-cell grouping contradiction do not transfer automatically when visible gaps carry no source-word/cell-count meaning; those failed contracts are not modified.
No native words receive meanings; none of the returned candidate spellings is adopted as a reading. No source corpus or native score/test has been run for this proposal.

predecessor_review.difference: Same familiar1/2/3minim ambiguity principle, not claimed new.975has a16-word source lexicon, explicit clause grammar, exact-name codes, PERIOD and marked continuations around visible logical word groups. Here open23-letter words use a globally encoded SPACE, with two homogeneous styles and no exact-name/period/continuation repair. The different necessary consequence is marker adjacency plus source-word-length cost in a continuous stream.

Encoded source spaces and discarded display gaps are already known.930requires exactly three source cells per nonfinal output group, with sixheads/tallies. The present proposal imposes no visible-group cell count and uses actual unresolved minim ambiguity;930's original short-group failure remains.

Its freeUD and complete-visible-group/source-word premises are both absent. Its fixed-source fourth-power exclusion remains correct and is not rerun or rescued.

retention_decision: Retain one genuinely distinct combination as RAW_UNREVIEWED, not a native writer or selected experiment. The first possible small decision concerns all20SPACE candidates under one prospectively fixed continuous scope; native selection and any later source-length gate belong to root.
